out_of_scope.reason: Nothing in the implemented subset creates a Cylinder. None of the 32 in-scope spells has one, and no engine monster has one. The engine has no Cylinder geometry, and a test would have to invent the API for it (geometry.in_area takes one size, so it can't take a radius and a height). Per CLAUDE.md, content the engine doesn't implement gets no tests.

The radius and height come from the creating effect, and no in-scope effect gives one. The threshold (radius boundary, height versus elevation) can't be exercised without a Cylinder creator. Stage A's height and elevation gap needs a ruling before such content is added.
The origin being included can be observed only through an effect that places a Cylinder, and none is in scope.

A.summary: GLOSS.cylinder defines the Cylinder area: its origin is at the centre of the circular top or bottom, the creating effect gives the base radius and the height, and the origin is included (unlike Cones and Cubes).
